title: 第2008章 又见天鹏吞龙第2007章 天雷仙界
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
不是，你有病吧？！
我们才刚见面，你就要送我们去死？！
整的好像咱们有仇似的！
雷鹏真仙的心里有千言万语想要说道说道，但在那磅礴的灵压下，尽数化为恭顺之色，谄媚道，“这位妖王，咱们之间也没什么大仇，您杀了我们也就得些灵物而已，拼死抵抗之下，还得折损不少。”
“不如听我一言：我等愿奉上买命钱，请熄雷霆之怒，如此两全其美，岂不快哉？”
笑话，将你们杀了就全是我的，还想折损我的灵物，你们有那个实力吗？
至于仇恨之说，更是无稽之谈。
什么时候虚空中杀戮，还需要看看有没有仇才能动手？！
一点主观能动性都没有。
顾安嗤笑一声，声音滚滚，牵动十方风雷，朝着一众真仙鹏妖，朝着它们的心头沉沉压下，“你们想活，倒是可以，谁若能为我提供那诸界船队的位置，我也不是那生性嗜杀的人。”
诸界船队的位置？！
雷鹏心中一沉，它们躲着走还来不及呢，怎会主动去打探位置？
但生死攸关，容不得它犹豫，翅膀拍着胸脯，保证道：“不就是诸界船队的位置嘛，我族最擅速度，愿为您打探。”
在它看来，收伏一众真仙妖兽，总比全杀了好吧。
尤其是还用得着它们的情况下。
那青袍妖兽很有可能同意。
但却不知道，顾安的最后一丝耐心也就此耗尽，“敕！”
本就是有枣没枣打一杆子，没枣就杀。
毕竟他不可能相信这群孽畜，万一散出去，泄了消息，反而更为不美。
不如全杀了。

一声落下，周天星辰戟自天穹坠落，杀机直锁一众真仙妖兽，星轨照下，使得它们甚至连逃窜的机会都没有。
寒芒凛冽，贯空而来。
“唳——”
关键时刻，还是雷鹏真仙自燃精血，取出一张仙符燃烧，这才带着一众真仙脱困。
然而，此时的周天星辰戟已经落到眼前。
轰！！
周天星辰戟闪烁寒光，沛然莫御，如天柱倾倒，轰然落下。
两只真仙中期的雷鹏尚有机会逃出，但几只真仙初期的妖兽可倒了血霉，在周天星辰戟的狂暴威力下，它们的一切底牌成了笑话，被生生碾碎。
数道炸声接连响起，几只妖兽变成几滩妖兽。
唳——
惊恐的唳鸣连连响起，杂乱中满是惊恐，几只真仙初期妖兽也顾不得什么了，当即神魂卷起道果，就要逃遁。
然而，却见数点寒星现。
千星万劫针一闪，将道果与神魂一并钉在空中。
“逃！”
见到这一幕，雷鹏真仙惊骇欲绝，再无侥幸之心。
这青袍妖兽比他想象的还要强，是那种完全无法抵抗的强，甚至比记载中的天雷鹏始祖还要强。
纵使集众之力，战于界内，也没有半分希望。
唯有逃！
幸好它还算有些身家，藏有一张七阶上品的遁术仙符护身，此时正派上用场。
配合它天雷鹏一族的急速，说不定真有逃生之机。
content_en:
No, are you sick? !
We just met and you want to send us to die? !
It’s as if we have a grudge!
True Immortal Lei Peng had thousands of words in his heart that he wanted to say, but under the majestic spiritual pressure, they all turned into a submissive expression and said flatteringly, "This demon king, there is no big hatred between us. If you kill us, you will only get some spiritual objects. After fighting to the death, you will lose a lot."
"Why don't you listen to me: We are willing to offer you the money to buy your life, and please extinguish the wrath of the thunder. Wouldn't it be nice to get the best of both worlds?"
What a joke. If I kill you all, it will all be mine. You also want to damage my spiritual creature. Do you have the strength?
As for the theory of hatred, it is even more nonsense.
When does killing in the void need to be done to see if there is any revenge? !
There is no subjective initiative at all.
Gu An sneered, his voice rolling, affecting the wind and thunder in all directions, heading towards the group of True Immortal Peng Demons, and weighing heavily on their hearts, "If you want to live, you can. If anyone can provide me with the position of the fleet of the worlds, I am not a murderous person by nature."
The location of the fleets of all realms? !
Lei Peng's heart sank. It was too late for them to hide away. How could they take the initiative to find out their location?
But life and death were at stake, and there was no room for hesitation. He flapped his wings against his chest and promised: "Isn't it the location of the fleets of all worlds? Our clan is the best at speed, and I would like to find out for you."
In its view, subduing a group of true immortal monsters is better than killing them all.
Especially if you still need them.
The green-robed monster is likely to agree.
But he didn't know that Gu An's last trace of patience was exhausted. "Imperative!"
Basically, if there are dates but there are no dates, you will hit a pole, and if there are no dates, you will kill.
After all, it was impossible for him to trust this group of evil beasts. If they dispersed and leaked the news, it would be even worse.
Might as well kill them all.
With a sound of falling, the Zhoutian Star Halberd fell from the sky, locking murderous intent on a group of true immortal monsters. The star path illuminated them, leaving them with no chance to escape.
The cold light came through the sky.
"唳——"
At the critical moment, True Immortal Lei Peng spontaneously ignited his essence and blood, took out an immortal talisman and burned it, and then led a group of True Immortals out of trouble.
However, at this time, the Zhoutian Star Halberd had already fallen in front of him.
boom! !
The stars and halberds in the sky flashed with cold light, and they were so powerful that they fell down like a pillar of heaven.
Two Lei Peng who were in the middle stage of True Immortal still had a chance to escape, but several monster beasts who were in the early stage of True Immortal were unlucky. Under the violent power of Zhoutian Star Halberd, all their trump cards became a joke and they were crushed to pieces.
Several explosions sounded one after another, and several monster beasts turned into several pools of monster beasts.
唳——
Frightened chirps sounded one after another, and the chaos was full of panic. Several early stage True Immortal monsters couldn't care less, and immediately their souls rolled up the Dao Fruit and fled.
However, several cold stars appeared.
Thousand Stars and Ten Thousand Calamity Needles flashed, nailing the Dao Fruit and the Divine Soul into the air.
"Escape!"
Seeing this scene, Immortal Lei Peng was horrified and had no chance to take any chances.
This green-robed monster was stronger than he imagined. It was so strong that it was completely irresistible. It was even stronger than the ancestor of the Thunder Peng in the records.
Even if we gather the strength of everyone and fight within the realm, there is no hope.
Only escape!
Fortunately, it still has some wealth, and it contains a seventh-grade high-grade escape magic talisman to protect it, which comes in handy at this time.
Coupled with the rapidity of the Tianleipeng clan, there might be a chance of escape.
